title: Video↔Project↔DB3+META binding (PipeChart / PACP / Inspected by)
description:
PipeShare now keeps project DB3 and companion META DB3 linked by stable file IDs so clicking a video resolves the right project files for PipeChart, PACP codes, and Inspected by. Plan Sync import and auto-highlight require both DB3 files. Shared Base Jobs/ + Uploaded by are unchanged.

Who is affected: crews using PipeShare pipe charts / PACP tables, and Plan Sync auto-highlight / WinCan import on BASE and SaaS.
changeLog: Reject META *_Meta.db3 as primary; prefer bound META companion for Inspected by
Durable video→project→DB3+META resolver + inspection pipeline v26 cache keys
Portal inspection-bindings bindingType=meta (GET returns meta map)
Backend /imports/wincan/preview accepts metaFile; Plan Sync requireMeta=1
Plan Sync auto-highlight gated on group.db3Pair (project + META)
Pipe-chart modules + META filter aligned from PIPELINK; cache-bust 20260914db3MetaBind
